intent: Resolve desynchronization between Header TextScaleDropdown and Settings AppearanceSection by engineering a canonical 7-tier zoom scaling architecture with 100% bidirectional reactivity.

root_cause_analysis.header_settings_desync: TextScaleDropdown maintained isolated local React state reading app_text_scale with 3 hardcoded options (100%, 110%, 125%), while Settings AppearanceSection read settingsStore.js (fontSize) with 4 keyword values ('standard', 'medium', 'large', 'xl'). This caused visible state divergence between the top navbar (125%) and settings page (140%).
root_cause_analysis.limited_zoom_tiers: The system lacked fine-grained scaling levels for high-DPI displays and low-vision accessibility (only 3 options in header, 4 in settings).

modifications.changes: Exported canonical ZOOM_OPTIONS with 7 tiers (75, 90, 100, 110, 125, 140, 150), added resolveZoomOption and centralized applyZoom handling root font size, CSS variables, data attributes, and dual storage.
Added font scaling CSS rules for all 7 zoom levels (compact/75 -> 0.75, small/90 -> 0.9, standard/100 -> 1.0, medium/110 -> 1.1, large/125 -> 1.25, xl/140 -> 1.4, max/150 -> 1.5).
Subscribed to useSettingsStore zoomLevel and setZoomLevel, mapping through all 7 ZOOM_OPTIONS with cross-tab storage listener.
Subscribed to useSettingsStore zoomLevel and setZoomLevel, mapping through all 7 ZOOM_OPTIONS with dynamic descriptor text.
Added comprehensive test suite validating all 7 zoom tiers and external store synchronization.
Created targeted test suite validating 7 zoom options, root document font scaling, external store sync, and high-contrast toggle.
